title: 36 Hours in Macau
abstract: Home to dozens of casinos, Macau can overwhelm the senses. But the former Portuguese colony also has a quieter side that’s defined by lush landscapes, art galleries and design shops.

title: 36 Hours in Cancún, Mexico
abstract: There’s more to Mexico’s top travel destination than alcohol-fueled partying. Take a look.

title: 36 Hours in Ljubljana, Slovenia
abstract: In this capital city, you’ll find castles and culture, local wine and creative cuisine, homegrown fashion and textured history.

title: 36 Hours in Kolkata, India
abstract: Strands of old and new are woven into a vibrant pattern in this state capital, from politics to art to food.

title: 36 Hours in Lijiang, China
abstract: With clear skies, a Himalayan horizon, culture and history, this Yunnan city has emerged as a new favorite of foreign visitors.
